space: canonical (Y up, character faces +Z, +X = character left, metres) - same as luigi.glb
rotation_convention: rotation = ABSOLUTE local (parent-relative) quaternion xyzw, directly comparable to the glb node rest rotation (replace, do not multiply). Godot: skeleton.set_bone_pose_rotation(bone, Quaternion(x,y,z,w)).
translation_convention: absolute local translation in metres (only joints whose translation leaves the rest value are listed); scale likewise.
source_notes: Evaluated with ports of ftAnimParseDObjFigatree / gcParseDObjAnimJoint / gcPlayDObjAnimJoint / lbCommonPlayTranslateScaledDObjAnim (60 Hz game frames, anim_speed 1, frame_begin 0). TopN is not animated by figatrees (its in-game rotation is lr*90deg about Y; here identity = facing +Z).

hips_yaw_deg.note: yaw (deg, about +Y, positive turns +Z toward +X = character left) of the hips forward axis relative to the rest pose. SSB64 idle/taunt poses turn the body toward the side-view camera; rotate j00 by -yaw to make such a pose face +Z.
